topic: Qwen3.8-27B overthinks coding tasks: the knobs that cut the waste
title: Qwen3.8-27B overthinks your code
description: Working value; the package stage overwrites.
hook_candidates: Three moves and your coder stops stalling tonight.
Your coder isn't slow. Its dial is glued.
You ask for one edit. It thinks for twenty-one minutes.
Qwen3.8-27B thinks itself out of answers.
19.4% of xhigh calls came back empty.
One prompt. Fourteen minutes of thinking.
Set two flags tonight, cut the thinking eight times.
xhigh or medium? Eight times the tokens decides.
narration_full: Twenty-one minutes for one vector image. You run it locally for coding. So: slow model. Same weights, medium effort: seventy-seven seconds a question, same typical score. Qwen three point eight gives thinking three stops: low, medium, x high. The chat template, the formatter behind every request, hands you the maximum when you set nothing. Generous. Set reasoning effort, the thinking-depth dial, to medium. Engines can ignore that, so add a hard cap: two thousand forty-eight thinking tokens. x high keeps the higher ceiling, and agent retries can eat the savings. Qwen says so itself. Dwim resolved sixty-four percent against fifty-two, same model, same issues. You never bought a slow model; the dial shipped glued.
